data.text: That works for me: I’ll choose 12 tons if all five of us agree to this month’s split. I learned to fish here with my family, and I want the lake to keep supporting our village. I also support Kate’s five-month rotation—each of us would catch 50 tons over the cycle, keeping things fair. Let’s confirm the full schedule together rather than leave future shares unclear. Jack, are you comfortable taking 10 tons this month?
